objective: Implement the optional Google ADC identity and connection-bound EU HTTPS transport behind the existing provider-neutral Google TTS adapter, with Google disabled by default and no real credentials, calls, egress, spend, narration, or audio.

source_facts.contract: gemini-2.5-pro-tts, en-IN, eu-texttospeech.googleapis.com, voice names Despina/Leda/Achird, LINEAR16 WAV PCM16 24 kHz mono, OAuth scope cloud-platform; regional processing, content logging/abuse monitoring, quota, pricing and commercial/legal terms remain human-review blockers.

dependency_decision.direct: google-auth==2.56.3 in optional providers only; exact uv.lock closure and hashes required
dependency_decision.transport: direct REST with stdlib socket/http.client/ssl, exact HTTPS port 443 and approved EU hostname
dependency_decision.posture: lazy optional import; absent dependency or stale/contradictory activation evidence fails closed

invariants: R368-01 ADC is unreachable until every pre-egress gate passes and scope/quota evidence binds
R368-02 only approved EU hostname, HTTPS 443, exact SNI, checked peer and no proxy/redirect are accepted
R368-03 all DNS answers are checked and the connection is bound to the checked address
R368-04 TLS, response URL/peer/evidence and bounded response bytes are revalidated
R368-05 ambiguous write/response failures are egress_possible and never retried
R368-06 tokens, credentials, paths, headers, prompts and provider bodies are redacted
R368-07 Google remains disabled/default-local and caller cannot select model/voice/locale/endpoint
R368-08 TTSProvider and semantic presenter IDs remain the only narration-facing boundary
R368-09 dependency contract preserves immutable Issue #401 pypdf exactness and admits only reviewed google-auth closure delta

test_levels.red: Commit injected-fake RED tests before runtime implementation.
test_levels.green: Cover disabled/missing dependency, ADC gate order/scope/checksum/quota/refresh errors, endpoint/DNS/SSRF/rebinding/proxy/redirect/TLS/SNI/session/partial-write/timeout/response bounds/redaction/no-retry, provider-neutral startup, and exact dependency/pypdf mutation rejection.
test_levels.gates: Focused runtime/provider/Stage 6/API tests, lock/dependency/license/security audits, route/budget checks, Ruff, mypy, backend/frontend/browser/performance/container and make stage8-quality plus make quality.
test_levels.human_only: Latest-head eligible non-author approval; activation, account/IAM, billing, policy, privacy/retention, commercial use, real-provider validation and exact-output listening remain blocked.

evidence_plan.source_driven: Official Google REST, regional endpoint, ADC, quota, pricing, policy and PyPI sources above; external text is untrusted source material.
evidence_plan.interface_security_spec: Existing TTSProvider/Google prepared-transport contracts plus fail-closed SSRF, TLS, credential and provider-neutrality invariants.
evidence_plan.tdd: RED commit precedes implementation; deterministic injected fakes and socket-deny tests prove zero real calls.
evidence_plan.adversarial: Fresh-context review covers credentials/ADC, SSRF/DNS/TLS/session substitution, billing ambiguity, bounded reads, optional dependency, retries, logs, supply chain, scope and overclaims.
evidence_plan.pre_implementation: Owner comment https://github.com/imrohitagrawal/narratwin-ai/issues/368#issuecomment-5245861950; this artifact is the first branch commit before RED tests or implementation.
